lume-grades.cap: Lume grades: daylight colour, then the glow at 0, 10, 30, 60 and 180 minutes after charging. Model brightness relative to C3; C1 to C9 are daylight colour codes, a white body glows weaker.

lume-ways.cap: Three ways lume reaches a dial, and how each shows by day and by night: printed on the dial, filled into an applied frame, sandwich under a cut-out.

daynight.cap: The Day · Night switch on one dial: the watch through one colour matrix (Krawczyk 2005, two stops down), the lume drawn on top; the photo look at 0 min, the eye at 45 min, bloom off.

closing.cap: Closing-up: the same 0.35 mm-high print with the ink spreading 0, 12 and 24 µm each side; the e's eye narrows, then fills.

misreg.cap: Misregistration: a white numeral printed over a red track, the second ink shifted 0, 30 and 60 µm; only visible where two inks meet.

edge.cap: Edge roughness of 15 µm: invisible at whole-watch size (50 µm a pixel), plain in a loupe (5 µm a pixel).

pad-vs-toner.cap: Okay's own method turned over: pad print sits on top of the brass; under the toner the brass stays up and the ground is etched down, matte, undercut at the edges.

eight-ways.cap: One mark made eight ways, seen through a loupe: pad print, screen print, toner-transfer etch, laser, galvanic gilt, decal, UV inkjet, applied index.

finest-v2.cap: Finest line and finest gap each method holds, as reported (mm, log scale): the dot is the middle of what sources report, the whisker the lowest to highest.

seven-finishes.cap: Seven finishes under one sun at 300°, plates only: flat, fumé, sunburst, linear brushed, grained, lacquer, enamel.

why-rays.cap: Why a sunburst's bright rays run across the light: a groove is a tiny cylinder; light that meets it side-on fans out to the eye; with the sun at 9 the grooves at 12 and 6 shine.

ink-heights.cap: One ink in three height shapes, reserved in #545's mm keys: flat, rim (coffee ring), dome (filled).

far-near.cap: Sunburst under a far sun and under a near lamp: the far sun gives a straight bow-tie; a near lamp bends it onto the circle whose diameter runs from the centre to the hotspot.

engraved-v2.cap: Engraved and stamped textures under one sun at 300°: clous de Paris, barleycorn, wave (flinqué ground), tapisserie, linen, azurage, snailing, bark.

stones.cap: Aventurine, mother-of-pearl, meteorite and carbon under one sun.

redraw.cap: Time to redraw one 800 px dial after the sun moves, headless Chromium, no GPU, three runs: grained 96 ms, enamel 46, sunburst with 720 wedges 40, the flat plate 21.

sweep.cap: A light-sweep sheet: one sunburst dial under four sun angles, then the same dial by night.
